feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 24 October 2026 5:59am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Gales/ severe gales.


##Wind)##

West or SW 4 or 5, backing and increasing South 7 or gale 8 through morning and early afternoon, possibly occasionally severe gale 9, veering West or SW 7 or gale 8 late afternoon or early evening. Increasing gale 8 or severe gale 9 late evening and tonight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, building rough or very rough.


##Weather)##

Fair, then heavy rain for a time, clearing later today.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 14°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Gales/ severe gales at first.


##Wind)##

West gale 8 or severe gale 9, very gradually decreasing 6 or 7 by the evening, then backing South or SW 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Rough or very rough, falling moderate later.


##Weather)##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 12°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C

##State of sea)##

##Weather)##

Fair, then rain for a time.


##Visibility)##

Good.
